Package com.bilt.pos.media

Class Capabilities

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.media.Capabilities
public final class Capabilities extends Object
What this SDK build and this register can render.

Capabilities travel with every decision request so the ad platform only serves what can be shown: the media formats the surfaces play, the Actions the register is prepared to handle, the Placements it has surfaces for and the SurfaceKind behind each. The platform filters its candidates against this before deciding. Should an unsupported creative still arrive — a video for an image-only banner, a SEND_TO_PHONE button the register did not declare — the SDK does not render it and reports nothing for it; it is treated as a miss.

getSdkVersion() lets the platform key behaviour to the SDK release rather than probing for features one by one.
